Appointments & Education

items: 高效人工智能与大模型协同设计
Efficient AI & Large-Model Co-Design
面向端侧大模型加速与部署，研究软硬件协同的高能效人工智能计算架构及其在具身智能中的应用。
Developing energy-efficient AI architectures through hardware-software co-design for on-device large-model acceleration and deployment, and their applications in embodied intelligence.
神经形态感知与计算
Neuromorphic Sensing & Computing
面向多模态神经形态感知与事件驱动计算系统，开展感内计算、感算融合、异步处理与高效片上学习研究。
Developing multimodal neuromorphic sensing and event-driven computing systems with in-sensor computing, sensing-computing integration, asynchronous processing, and efficient on-chip learning.
存内计算处理器
Computing-in-Memory Processors
面向高能效、高吞吐量边缘计算，研究基于多种存储介质的存内计算架构与芯片设计。
Developing computing-in-memory architectures and chip designs based on diverse memory technologies for energy-efficient, high-throughput edge AI computing.

Research Interests

items: 神经形态电荷域人工神经网络与脉冲神经网络混合存算一体处理器                 2025.09至2026.09
Neuromorphic Hybrid Charge-Domain ANN/SNN Compute-In-Memory Processor   Sep. 2025 – Sep. 2026
提出支持人工神经网络与脉冲神经网络双模式计算的事件驱动电荷域存算一体处理器，并集成可配置片上网络，实现灵活的核间通信与数据流调度。
Developed a dual-mode CIM processor supporting both ANN and SNN computation, with a configurable on-chip NoC for flexible inter-core communication and dataflow.
神经形态异步脉冲视觉传感器  2023.11至2026.02
Neuromorphic Asynchronous Spiking Vision Sensor  Nov. 2023 – Feb. 2026
提出基于脉冲编码、像素内处理与异步读出的事件驱动视觉传感器，实现高速、高动态范围感知。
Developed an event-driven vision sensor with spike-based encoding, in-pixel processing, and asynchronous readout for high-speed and high-dynamic-range sensing.
支持高效片上学习的神经形态感-存-算一体芯片与系统                    2024.05至2025.08
Neuromorphic Sense-Memory-Compute Chip and System with Efficient On-Chip Learning    May 2024 – Aug. 2025
提出具备高效片上学习能力的事件驱动脉冲型感-存-算神经形态系统，引入三值梯度与格雷码权重更新机制，提升学习效率与存储器耐久性。

Developed an event-driven neuromorphic sense-memory-compute system with efficient on-chip learning, incorporating ternary-gradient and Gray-code-based weight updates to improve learning efficiency and memory endurance.
基于 SRAM 的脉冲驱动电荷域存算一体计算宏                                   2023.10至2025.02
SRAM-Based Spiking Charge-Domain Compute-In-Memory Macro                   Oct. 2023 – Feb. 2025
提出基于动态电荷共享的事件驱动电容型突触与神经元电路，并实现脉冲电荷域存算一体计算宏，支持无静态直流电流的低功耗脉冲神经网络计算。
Developed event-driven capacitive synapses and neurons using dynamic charge sharing, enabling low-power SNN computation without static DC current.
基于 MRAM 的双脉冲异步编码与存算一体计算宏                2022.11至2023.10
MRAM-Based Dual-Spike-Driven Compute-In-Memory Macro                Nov. 2022 – Oct. 2023
提出基于 MRAM 的双脉冲驱动异步自控制存算一体架构，在降低通信带宽与推理延迟的同时提升计算能效。
Developed a dual-spike-driven MRAM CIM architecture to reduce communication bandwidth and inference latency while improving energy efficiency.
